targetTest: An empty plugin reference is rejected as an empty plugin name - #1.5
expected: One usage-error payload per command whose message names the empty field: Plugin name must not be empty. for install with an empty or blank reference and for plugin info with an empty reference, and Marketplace name must not be empty. for plugin list with an empty marketplace name. Each payload keeps kind usage-error, severity error, needs reload false, and the verb's own usage line.
actual: install and info report Invalid <plugin>@<marketplace> ref: "". (and "   " for the blank install row) with the right kind, severity, and usage; plugin list '' is not rejected at all and returns a cascade payload at severity info that lists a marketplace named "".
semanticAssessment: Eight scenarios ran: the four rows from the earlier plan (#1.1 to #1.4: uninstall '', uninstall '   ', enable '', disable '') passed, and the four new targets failed only at the result has these fields step after Pi started and ran the command. Rows #1.5 (install ''), #1.6 (install '   '), and #1.7 (info '') differ on the message row alone: today's handlers split the reference before any empty check and report Invalid <plugin>@<marketplace> ref: "". The list scenario fails because the payload kind is cascade at severity info with no message or usage: the list handler accepts an empty marketplace name and lists nothing. Both are the D-06 defect; there is no setup, load, or unrelated failure.
